product_metadata.title: PHF Cotton Waffle Weave Pillow Sham Covers Standard Size, 2 Pack Luxurious Yarn Dyed Pillowcases, Soft Breathable Skin-Friendly Pillow Cases, 20" X 26", No Filling, Pale Purple
features: Natural Pre-Washed Cotton: These waffle pillow shams made of 100% selected Egyptian cotton are ultra soft, breathable, safe, skin & hair friendly for you and your family. Because of high air permeability and absorption of premium cotton, our 100% cotton pillow shams can keep always fresh and clean, providing dreamy comfortable sleep environment all year round.

Waffle Weave Pattern: Classic waffle weave design of the pillow sham covers feature puffy and warmth appearance, chic and sophisticated touch. Available in neutral solid colors, these pillow shams perfectly complement any home décor.

Unique Yarn-Dyed Texture: Compared with normal printing technology, we use more delicate and expensive yarn-dyed texture process to craft this luxurious pillow covers, colors feature a greater depth and better consistency and the patterns turn out to be more dimensional and elegant.
Overlap Closure Design: The pillow cover has an delicate opening at the back. Unique designed envelope overlap closure can cover, protect, and keep your pillow clean and in place
Package Include: PHF 100% Cotton Waffle Weave Pillow Shams, Standard Size, 20" X 26", pack of 2. Covers only, no pillow insert.
